ValidationRule.description: If you choose non-compatible integration for subreason, please list the PMS.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT($Setup.ValidationSetting__c.ByPassAllValidationRules__c), RecordType.DeveloperName = "SWAT", OR( AND( ISPICKVAL(Cancellation_Subreason__c , "Non-Compatible Integration"), ISCHANGED(Cancellation_Subreason__c) ), AND( ISPICKVAL( Secondary_Cancellation_Subreason__c , "Non-Compatible Integration"), ISCHANGED(Secondary_Cancellation_Subreason__c) ) ), ISBLANK (Non_Integrated_PMS__c) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please enter the non compatible practice management software
